description: This file defines a Node.js module that exports a function to add an 'ncc' plugin to a task, which uses the '@vercel/ncc' package to compile JavaScript files. It also includes a helper function to generate a minimal package.json and license files for the compiled output.

methods.name: writePackageManifest
methods.description: Creates a minimal package.json and optional LICENSE file for a compiled package, based on the package's original package.json and license files.
